notes: P1: the one focus primitive (10a-spec §1) on each host: Card, Btn primary/secondary, Chip, NavItem, Sources row.
Rest = the host drawn with focus elsewhere; lit = ring (160 ms) + spring (~320 ms) at rest, so settle >= 600 ms.
Home opens with focus on the hero's Play (primary Btn, hasTVPreferredFocus). DOWN moves to row 0 card 0.
Fixture assumption: /api/home rows are [continue (frame cards), recent (NEW), mixed rows...]; row 2 is the first poster row.
Chips live in Browse's filter panel (RIGHT opens it, 280 ms slide); focus lands on the active category chip (on).
Sources row: Detail of ${id1} (the fixture film with a stream source) -> the inline Sources panel; set --var id1=<fixture id>.

states.name: card-rest
states.note: focus on hero Play; every card in every row unlit (ring 0, scale 1, highlight 0)

states.name: card-lit
states.note: row 0 card 0 lit: ring on after 160 ms, scale/lift spring at rest; the column slid up (hero.ty) — traced

states.name: btn-primary-rest
states.note: focus moved to Details: Play (primary) at rest, Details (secondary) lit

states.name: btn-secondary-lit
states.note: same frame as btn-primary-rest but traced: Details' ring and spring

states.name: btn-secondary-rest
states.note: Details unlit while Play is lit (same capture as btn-primary-lit, kept as its own row in the table)

states.name: chip-on-lit
states.note: filter panel open; focus lands on the active category chip 'All' (on + lit)

states.name: chip-lit
states.note: 'Trending' lit (not on); 'All' is on at rest — the same frame covers chip rest (every other chip), chip lit and chip on

states.name: chip-rest
states.note: 'New' lit; 'Trending' back at rest after a lit->rest transition (ring release, spring back to 1)

states.name: navitem-lit
states.note: LEFT on Play opens the rail (rail-opener path, 10d §4); focus lands on the active section's NavItem 'Home' (lit)

states.name: sources-row-lit
states.note: Detail: DOWN from Play to the Sources button, OK opens the inline Sources panel; the first source row lit. Needs the fixture film ${id1} to have >= 1 stream source.
